description: PathOS /map UI collision matrix — before & after Stage 7B-A.3 fixes

before.rootCause: Both overlays anchor at right-3 top-3; profile is rendered AFTER toolbar in DOM, so profile visually covers toolbar when both visible
before.description: Desktop profile popover occupies the exact same corner anchor as the MapToolbar. Selecting a university POI while a regional metric is active makes the regional select + state button unreachable without closing the profile first.
before.suggestedResolution: Shift profile wrapper to top-14 (below the 56px nav + 1rem gap) or move toolbar above profile in stacking order with offset.

before.rootCause: Dropdown opens leftward; sibling chip directly left has no inset clearance
before.description: State selector dropdown opens to the left (right-0 anchor) and overlaps the RegionalLayerControl chip inside the same toolbar row.
before.suggestedResolution: Increase gap in toolbar wrapper, or anchor dropdown to bottom-anchor the row above instead of overlapping.

before.elementA: UniversityProfile (desktop hidden md:block but active state)
before.rootCause: At 768px, profile wrapper is 360px and the map area is only ~408px wide; profile covers toolbar and crowds the map.
before.description: On Tablet the desktop profile popover is too wide; at 768x1024 it covers the entire toolbar and leaves little usable map area.
before.suggestedResolution: Reduce profile width on tablet (md:w-[320px] lg:w-[360px]) and shift down to clear toolbar.

before.rootCause: Currently gated correctly (md:hidden wrapper), but no Escape handler in BottomSheet — keyboard users can't close without finding the collapse button.
before.description: BottomSheet does not respond to Escape; not a visual collision but an interaction gap.
before.suggestedResolution: Add Escape handler to BottomSheet via useEffect.

before.rootCause: Both anchors are bottom-right; legend overlaps attribution
before.description: Legend bottom-right corner overlaps MapLibre attribution control. Attribution becomes unreadable behind legend at 1440px+.
before.suggestedResolution: Move attribution to bottom-center (or move legend up to bottom-20 with reserved space).

before.blockedControl: Legend is behind profile at narrow viewport
before.rootCause: Profile height is 100% - 1.5rem = ~735px; covers legend at bottom-right corner
before.description: At 1366x768, desktop profile (360px wide, full height minus 1.5rem) covers the RegionalLegend almost entirely. Legend text becomes unreadable behind profile.
before.suggestedResolution: When profile open, hide legend OR move legend to bottom-left.

before.rootCause: Tooltip positions at left: x+14 with no edge-flip when near right edge of viewport
before.description: On 320px viewport, hovering a POI near the right edge produces a tooltip that overflows the screen (clipped or scrolled out).
before.suggestedResolution: Add edge-flip logic: when (x + tooltipWidth + 14) > viewportWidth, position at (x - tooltipWidth - 14) instead.

before.rootCause: Tooltip positions at top: y+12 with no edge-flip when near bottom of viewport
before.description: Hovering a state polygon near the bottom of the map overflows below the viewport.
before.suggestedResolution: Add edge-flip logic to flip top when (y + tooltipHeight + 12) > viewportHeight.

before.blockedControl: City drilldown card overlaps map but is not visible on mobile when BottomSheet covers it
before.rootCause: City card has no md:hidden gating; it persists on mobile and may be visually buried by BottomSheet's expanded state.
before.description: On mobile when cityDrilldownEnabled and a state is selected, the city drilldown card floats top-left but BottomSheet takes the bottom; card content is hidden by user scrolling.
before.suggestedResolution: Add `hidden md:block` to city drilldown card (city data is duplicated in the map anyway).

before.rootCause: ComparePanel position not yet inventoried (Phase 1); check actual location
before.description: ComparePanel renders conditionally. Need to confirm it doesn't overlap legend/attribution at narrow widths.
before.suggestedResolution: Inventory ComparePanel position; adjust z-index and reservation if it overlaps legend.

before.blockedControl: Collapse button / drag handle partially obscured
before.description: On iOS the home indicator can cover the BottomSheet drag handle.

before.blockedControl: Toolbar buttons pushed off-screen on narrow viewport
before.rootCause: Sidebar takes 360px from right; toolbar overlaps sidebar at 768px (map area only 408px wide)
before.description: On tablet the sidebar + toolbar compete for the right side. Toolbar may be partially covered by sidebar at narrow widths.
before.suggestedResolution: Hide sidebar on tablet (use md:hidden + lg:block on sidebar) and rely on BottomSheet for tablet.

before.rootCause: Loading overlay has z-20 (raw) and may not have pointer-events-none
before.description: Loading overlay covers the map entirely; should not block map events when ready.
before.suggestedResolution: Confirm loading overlay pointer-events-none; replace z-20 with z-map-modal.

before.rootCause: Map-zindex policy forbids raw z-10/20/30 in /map
before.description: MapCanvas uses raw z-10 for an attribution placeholder element and raw z-20 for the loading overlay. Violates the Stage 7B-A.1 z-index token policy.
before.suggestedResolution: Replace z-10 with z-map-basemap and z-20 with z-map-modal.

before.rootCause: Both tooltips use raw z-index values instead of z-map-tooltip token
before.description: Two tooltips share the same purpose (hover info) but use different raw z-indexes. Violates token policy and creates potential stacking ambiguity.
before.suggestedResolution: Replace z-30 and z-50 with z-map-tooltip token.

before.rootCause: Long metric label "chinese_population" (or Chinese "华人水平") may force toolbar wrap at narrow widths
before.description: Toolbar has flex-wrap and a generous max-width; long labels force wrap but do not currently overlap.
before.suggestedResolution: Add `min-w-0` + `truncate` on each chip's text span; cap select width.

before.anchorA: grid h-6 w-6 text-ink/40 hover:bg-line/30 hover:text-ink
before.rootCause: Close button icon at text-ink/40 in dark mode may fall below 4.5:1 contrast
before.description: Dark mode close button X icon may have low contrast on dark panel.
before.suggestedResolution: Audit and adjust text-ink/40 → text-ink/55 or add a visible border for dark mode.

after.note: Profile shifted to top-14 (below nav + 1rem gap). At 1920x1080 they no longer overlap. At narrow viewports the toolbar wrap sits above the profile header.
after.remainingConcern: At 1024x768 with profile open, toolbar may still graze profile — but the profile is no longer in the same corner anchor, only side-by-side vertically stacked.
